[[Po Town]] }}'''Flash and Cosmog's Secret''' (Japanese: '''一閃！！ほしぐもちゃんの秘密！''' ''Flash!! {{tt|Hoshigumo-chan|Nebby}}'s Secret!'') is the 14th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} {{incomplete plot}} ==Major events== * {{adv|Moon}} battles and defeats a {{pkmn2|Totem}} {{p|Lurantis}} for training. * {{adv|Sun}} and Moon meet [[Professor Kukui]]'s wife, [[Professor Burnet]]. * Professor Burnet reveals that [[Nebby]] is capable of opening [[Ultra Wormhole]]s and may be responsible for the [[Ultra Beast]]s appearing in [[Alola]]. * Kukui tells Burnet to take [[Lillie]] with her and meet up with him, Sun, and Moon at [[Ula'ula Island]]. * [[Lana]], [[Mallow]], and [[Kiawe]] decide to investigate [[Po Town]] to see if [[Team Skull]] knows anything about the Ultra Beasts. * Mallow decides to call [[Ilima]] and [[Acerola]] for their assistance. * [[Gladion]] arrives at Po Town for the first time, where he meets [[Plumeria]], the Team Skull Admin. * A {{adv|Zygarde}} {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Zygarde|Core}} spies on Gladion. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Humans==== * [[Plumeria]] ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Lurantis}} ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Sun}} * {{adv|Moon}} * [[Professor Kukui]] * [[Professor Burnet]] * [[Lillie]] * [[Ilima]] (silhouette) * [[Lana]] * [[Kiawe]] * [[Mallow]] * [[Acerola]] (silhouette) * [[Gladion]] * [[Kahili]] * [[Lusamine]] (flashback) * [[Plumeria]] * {{tc|Team Skull Grunt}}s * Townspeople ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Meowth}} ([[Cent]];
